items.item_text: 01. I have a 2026-2027 Award Letter from Financial Aid Office Options: Yes | No
02. I understand that I must be enrolled at least 6 units in Fall 2026 to be eligible for this program. Options: Yes | No
03. I understand that while I may apply for more than one position, I can only be employed in one student worker position at a time. Options: Yes | No
04. I understand that my award may be reduced if I received loans, scholarships, or other forms of financial aid. Options: Yes | No

05. By checking yes, I agree and certify that I have read and meet all the requirements to participate in one of the student employment programs listed on this application. Also, I agree to all the conditions listed on this application and I am aware that my application may be denied if I provide inaccurate information. Options: Yes | No
06. What is your major? (Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Geology, Mathematics, Physics.
07. What career field/occupation do you plan to pursue?
Student must be enrolled in a minimum of 6 units in the Fall 2026 semester.
Must complete a TB test at time of employment.
General flexible hours not to exceed 20 hours per week.
